title: Vesuvius Radar
intro: Everything this page shows is open JSON, CSV and RSS over HTTPS, and the whole radar is also an MCP server, so a script, a spreadsheet, a feed reader or an agent can use it. No key, no login and no GPU quota: anyone can call it, logged in or not.

sources.title: MCP server for agents
sources.license: Item titles, summaries and links belong to their sources (arXiv, GitHub, Hugging Face, PyPI, Zenodo, Crossref, OpenAlex, the Vesuvius Challenge blog and YouTube channel, and news outlets found through Google News, Bing News and Hacker News); the radar's code is Apache 2.0
sources.note: Streamable HTTP, no session, JSON replies, no key. Eleven tools: search_items (by words or by meaning), get_item, find_similar, weekly_digest, top_picks, briefing, overview, source_status, check_now, list_views, get_settings.

sources.title: JSON API, CSV and RSS
sources.license: Item titles, summaries and links belong to their sources; the radar's code is Apache 2.0
sources.note: since takes 1m up to 30d (default 1d); view takes all, research, team or builders. The same filters work on items, overview, picks, briefing, export.csv and feed.xml; week takes an ISO week (2026-W48), this or last. The OpenAPI page lists every parameter.
